oracle_rule.headroom: positive means oracle better than selected; max metrics use oracle-selected, min metrics use selected-oracle
oracle_rule.per_metric: best candidate over numeric quality metrics in candidate_metrics
oracle_rule.primary_metric: auto: psnr_gain, candidate_psnr, then preferred metric order
oracle_rule.tie_break: prefer selected variant on exact metric ties, otherwise lexical variant name

target_gt_or_render_requirement: none beyond metrics already recorded in report candidate_metrics
